info.name: Apache ActiveMQ REST Management Messages API
Apache ActiveMQ Receive Message from Destination

params.name: destination
params.description: Name of the queue or topic destination.

params.name: type
params.description: Destination type — queue or topic. Defaults to topic.

params.name: clientId
params.description: Persistent consumer identifier; no session cookie needed when provided.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Time in milliseconds to wait for a message to arrive before returning.

params.name: oneShot
params.description: If true, the consumer is closed after receiving a single message.

items.docs: Receives (consumes) a single message from the specified queue or topic. Supports session-based and clientId-based consumption, message selectors, and timeouts.

info.name: Apache ActiveMQ Send Message to Destination

params.name: destination
params.description: Name of the queue or topic destination.

params.name: type
params.description: Destination type — queue or topic. Defaults to topic.

params.name: clientId
params.description: Persistent consumer identifier for durable subscriptions.

items.docs: Sends a message to the specified queue or topic. The destination is specified as a path parameter and the type (queue or topic) via a query parameter.

info.name: Apache ActiveMQ Receive Message Using Destination Parameter

params.name: destination
params.description: Full destination URI in the form queue://name or topic://name.

params.name: oneShot
params.description: If true, auto-close after receiving a single message.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Time in milliseconds to wait for a message.

items.docs: Receives a message from the specified destination using a query parameter. Supports oneShot mode for one-time consumption.

info.name: Apache ActiveMQ Send Message Using Destination Parameter

params.name: destination
params.description: Full destination URI in the form queue://name or topic://name.

items.docs: Sends a message to the specified destination using a query parameter to supply the full destination URI (e.g., queue://orders.input or topic://events.order).
